hero.headline: One interface.
hero.intro: Asphyxia-UI replaces your unit frames, bars, bags, chat, map and Blizzard windows with one dark, neon-lit design: gunmetal panels, cyan-to-pink accents and skull artwork, made only for WoW Forever.

support.title: Keep the skull burning
support.text: Asphyxia-UI is free. Join the community, watch the build videos, or chip in to keep development going.
